# Tano Core 0.2.0

- Add an animated butterfly assistant with reduced-motion support and an idle-selection interaction.
- Improve editor responsiveness with cached decorations, shared Markdown parsing and scheduled block geometry.
- Preserve inline Markdown input and IME completion, and coalesce background workspace refreshes.
- Add workspace breadcrumbs and improve comments, suggestions and assistant change review.
- Keep Markdown files, portable workspace identity and conflict-safe writes unchanged.

This compatible feature release requires no workspace data migration. Local validation is recorded in the release commit.
